scope: 28 file-content replacements: 26 lead previews plus two extra For a Reason colour images; six existing warm Bone lead previews retained.
limitations: Local preparation only; no Shopify or UI used by this joining task.
Snapshot CDN cache versions may predate in-place replacements. Match exact filenames and live product references.
This immutable plan is not current deployment status; deployment-progress.json is maintained by the UI agent.
Visual changes do not establish supplier accuracy, fulfilment readiness or storefront availability.

visualQA.method: Viewed the original source and output locally with view_image.

Correct front/back view, garment/cap colour, wording, line layout and accent thread/print colours retained.
Warm seamless Bone-family backdrop; no horizon, sunlight bands, props or white border.
Square framing and soft contact shadow.
visualQA.limitation: Generative mockups are visually checked; product pixels, wrinkles and proportions are not mathematically identical to the source.
